Orn.builder_notes: Standard linear assembly support for ornithine as a conservative peptide monomer.

Cit.builder_notes: Bootstrapped v0.2 skeleton; assembly fragment and attachment semantics not yet curated.

Aib.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for alpha-aminoisobutyric acid (Aib) as an achiral alpha-amino-acid-like peptide monomer.

THI.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for THI interpreted conservatively as L-thienylalanine-like alpha-amino-acid peptide monomer.

S5.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for S5 interpreted conservatively as the unstapled alpha-amino-acid building block (S)-2-(4-pentenyl)alanine. No crosslink/staple closure is inferred automatically.

R8.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for R8 interpreted conservatively as the unstapled alpha-amino-acid building block (R)-alpha-methyl-alpha-(7-octenyl)glycine / 2-(7-octenyl)alanine. No crosslink/staple closure is inferred automatically.

AZALA.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for Azulenyl-Alanine (AzAla / AZALA) interpreted conservatively as an L alpha-amino-acid-like aromatic side-chain monomer.

DIP.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for Dip / diphenylalanine interpreted as 3,3-diphenyl-L-alanine, an L alpha-amino-acid-like hydrophobic aromatic residue used in synthetic antimicrobial peptides.

HTRP.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for HTrp / 5-hydroxytryptophan interpreted as L-5-hydroxytryptophan, an L alpha-amino-acid-like indole residue with a 5-hydroxyl substituent.

SEP.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for phosphoserine / O-phospho-L-serine (SEP) as an L alpha-amino-acid-like phosphorylated residue.

LYS-C16.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for Nε-palmitoyl-L-lysine / Lys-C16 interpreted as a lysine residue bearing a palmitoyl amide on the side-chain epsilon amine.

CF3-BPG.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for L-CF3-Bpg interpreted as 3-(trifluoromethyl)bicyclo[1.1.1]pent-1-ylglycine, a rigid hydrophobic fluorinated alpha-amino-acid-like residue used in synthetic antimicrobial peptides.

PHG.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for L-phenylglycine (Phg), an alpha-amino-acid-like aromatic residue lacking the benzylic methylene of phenylalanine.

HPHE.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for L-homophenylalanine (hPhe), a methylene-extended phenylalanine analogue.

HOF.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for Hof interpreted from SATPdb evidence as homophenylalanine. This aliases the same chemistry as hPhe while preserving source nomenclature where Hof is used explicitly.

BIP.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for L-biphenylalanine / L-bPhe, interpreted as 4-biphenylyl-L-alanine.

D-CF3-BPG.builder_notes: First-pass linear assembly support for D-CF3-Bpg interpreted as the D enantiomer of 3-(trifluoromethyl)bicyclo[1.1.1]pent-1-ylglycine.

PCA.builder_notes: First-pass support for N-terminal pyroglutamate / pyrrolidone carboxylic acid (pE/PCA) as a pre-cyclized N-terminus residue. N-terminus is blocked; only C-terminal peptide extension is allowed.

DHA.builder_notes: First-pass support for dehydroalanine (Dha) as a linear dehydroamino-acid placeholder in lantibiotic-style sequences, without lanthionine bridge reconstruction.

DHB.builder_notes: First-pass support for dehydrobutyrine (Dhb) as a linear dehydroamino-acid placeholder in lantibiotic-style sequences, without methyllanthionine bridge reconstruction.

NMe-Ala.builder_notes: Bootstrapped v0.2 skeleton; assembly fragment and attachment semantics not yet curated.

NMe-Leu.builder_notes: Bootstrapped v0.2 skeleton; assembly fragment and attachment semantics not yet curated.

Dab.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for 2,4-diaminobutyric acid (Dab) as extended L-lysine-like monomer with additional amine on sidechain.

NDab.builder_notes: Source-specific linear assembly support for NDab interpreted as the peptoid analogue of Dab (N-substituted glycine with 2-aminoethyl side chain) in DOI 10.3390/molecules24244429.

NhLys.builder_notes: Source-specific linear assembly support for NhLys interpreted as the peptoid analogue of homolysine (N-(5-aminopentyl)glycine) in DOI 10.3390/molecules24244429.

beta3-hAla.builder_notes: Bootstrapped v0.2 skeleton; assembly fragment and attachment semantics not yet curated.

βALA.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for recovered DBAASP/DBASP beta-alanine (βAla) N-terminal residues. Assembly seed is alpha-compatible for the current first-pass sidecar; canonical_smiles preserves the beta-alanine structure.

AEEA.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for recovered DBAASP/DBASP AEEA interpreted as 8-amino-3,6-dioxaoctanoic acid / aminoethoxyethoxyacetic acid linker. Assembly seed is alpha-compatible for the current first-pass sidecar; canonical_smiles preserves the linker structure.

Ahx.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for 6-aminohexanoic acid / aminocaproic acid linker (Ahx) as an aminoalkanoic spacer in otherwise linear chains.

ΒF.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for recovered DOI 10.1021/acschembio.7b00843 beta-phenylalanine (ΒF). Assembly seed is alpha-compatible for the current first-pass sidecar; canonical_smiles preserves the simple beta-amino-acid backbone.

ΒI.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for recovered DOI 10.1021/acschembio.7b00843 beta-isoleucine (ΒI). Assembly seed is alpha-compatible for the current first-pass sidecar; canonical_smiles preserves the simple beta-amino-acid backbone.

ΒS.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for recovered DOI 10.1021/acschembio.7b00843 beta-serine (ΒS). Assembly seed is alpha-compatible for the current first-pass sidecar; canonical_smiles preserves the simple beta-amino-acid backbone.

ΒK.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for recovered DOI 10.1021/acschembio.7b00843 beta-lysine (ΒK). Assembly seed is alpha-compatible for the current first-pass sidecar; canonical_smiles preserves the simple beta-amino-acid backbone.

ΒL.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for recovered DOI 10.1021/acschembio.7b00843 beta-leucine (ΒL). Assembly seed is alpha-compatible for the current first-pass sidecar; canonical_smiles preserves the simple beta-amino-acid backbone.

norVal.builder_notes: Bootstrapped v0.2 skeleton; assembly fragment and attachment semantics not yet curated.

norLeu.builder_notes: Bootstrapped v0.2 skeleton; assembly fragment and attachment semantics not yet curated.

Dap.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for 2,3-diaminopropionic acid (Dap) as extended L-ornithine-like monomer with additional amine on sidechain.

hArg.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for homoarginine (hArg) as extended L-Arg-like monomer.

dTyr.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for deoxytyrosine (dTyr) as L-Tyr-like monomer with deoxygenated phenol ring.

Hor.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for homophenylalanine (Hor) as L-Phe-like monomer.

hPhe.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for homophenylalanine (hPhe) as L-Phe-like monomer.

Hof.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for Hof interpreted from SATPdb evidence as homophenylalanine, kept as a separate source-facing alias from hPhe.

betaNPhe4F.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for beta-(4-fluorophenyl)alanine (betaNPhe(4-F)) as L-Phe-like monomer with beta-aryl sidechain.

O.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for ornithine (Orn/O) as extended L-lysine-like monomer with additional amine on sidechain.

NLE.builder_notes: Conservative linear assembly support for norleucine (Nle/NLE) as linear hydrocarbon sidechain extended leucine analog.

Nprp.description: N-propargylglycine peptoid (Nprp), matching peptoid-calculator style literature notation.

N4-MeBn.description: N-(4-methylbenzyl)glycine peptoid, matching explicit N4-MeBn literature notation.

NORN.description: N-ornithine peptoid interpreted conservatively as N-(3-aminopropyl)glycine, aligned with recurring [NOrn] notation in the curated NNAA set.

NBu.description: N-butylglycine peptoid, matching explicit NBu literature notation.

Nap.description: N-(3-aminopropyl)glycine peptoid (Nap), matching the Langmuir 2016 peptoid repeat notation.

Ndp.description: N-(2,2-diphenylethyl)glycine peptoid (Ndp), matching the Langmuir 2016 peptoid repeat notation.

Nnm.description: N-(1-naphthylmethyl)glycine peptoid (Nnm), matching the Langmuir 2016 peptoid repeat notation.

N1-Nal.description: N-(1-naphthylmethyl)glycine peptoid, matching explicit N1-Nal literature notation.

NSSB.description: Nssb peptoid interpreted conservatively as N-[(S)-sec-butyl]glycine based on recurring [Nssb] notation paired with [NLys]/[Nspe] peptoid-style residues.

1-NAL.builder_notes: 1-naphthylalanine side chain isomer treated as a distinct single residue for notation normalization.

2-NAL.builder_notes: 2-naphthylalanine side chain isomer treated as a distinct single residue for notation normalization.

ΒNSCE.description: N-(S)-1-cyclohexylethyl-β-alanine peptidomimetic residue from DOI 10.3390/ijms22115617 Table 1 footnote.

ΒNSPE.description: N-(S)-1-phenylethyl-β-alanine peptidomimetic residue from DOI 10.3390/ijms22115617 Table 1 footnote.

ΒNPHE.description: N-benzyl-β-alanine peptidomimetic residue from DOI 10.3390/ijms22115617 Table 1 footnote.

ΒNCHA.description: N-cyclohexylmethyl-β-alanine peptidomimetic residue from DOI 10.3390/ijms22115617 Table 1 footnote.

ΒNPHE(F).description: N-(4-fluorobenzyl)-β-alanine peptidomimetic residue from DOI 10.3390/ijms22115617 Table 1 footnote.

ΒNPHE(F3).description: N-(3,4,5-trifluorobenzyl)-β-alanine peptidomimetic residue from DOI 10.3390/ijms22115617 Table 1 footnote.

ACM-CYS.builder_notes: Notation-only support for S-acetamidomethyl cysteine (Acm-Cys). This entry resolves representation-layer monomer IDs but deliberately disables automatic structure assembly until curated free-residue and linkage semantics are added.

6-BR-TRP.builder_notes: Notation-only support for 6-bromotryptophan. This entry resolves representation-layer monomer IDs but deliberately disables automatic structure assembly until curated halogenated tryptophan residue geometry is added.
